description: This line plot illustrates how the minimum FDE20 metric (minFDE₂₀, in units of meters, labeled on the y-axis) changes across different ratios of the in-context pool size, as represented by the x-axis labeled "Ratio" ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale. The plot displays five distinct methods, each represented by a different colored line with a unique marker: TrajICL (blue, circle markers, solid line), Head Tuning (orange, triangle markers, solid line), FT (green, square markers, solid line), LoRA 16 (red, diamond markers, solid line), and LoRA 64 (purple, pentagon markers, solid line). For TrajICL, the value starts at approximately 0.90 when the ratio is 0.0 and remains nearly constant at around 0.89–0.90 until the ratio reaches 1.0, where it slightly decreases to 0.88. The Head Tuning line begins at approximately 1.31 at a ratio of 0.0 and steadily declines to approximately 1.08 at a ratio of 1.0. The FT line starts at approximately 1.10 at a ratio of 0.0, decreases to approximately 0.90 at a ratio of 1.0, and shows a slight dip around a ratio of 0.6. The LoRA 16 line begins at approximately 1.21 at a ratio of 0.0 and declines to approximately 0.92 at a ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 64 line starts at approximately 1.21 at a ratio of 0.0, decreases to approximately 0.93 at a ratio of 1.0, and exhibits a slight dip around a ratio of 0.6.
